# Pull Request

## What does this change?

Describe the change in plain language.

## Why does it matter?

Explain the problem or opportunity this addresses.

## Evidence or reasoning

What supports the proposal? Distinguish research, experiments, observations, and preferences.

## Human impact

How does this affect the experience or capability of a creator?

## Trade-offs

What does this improve, and what might it make worse?

## Checklist

- [ ] I read the relevant Glyt documentation.
- [ ] I explained the idea clearly enough for non-specialists to follow when appropriate.
- [ ] I have not treated an experimental idea as a settled decision.
- [ ] I considered whether this adds necessary complexity.
- [ ] I considered whether this preserves human agency and capability.
